thread:
Asha (Finance Ops): Vendor Kaito Tech sent invoice KT-2026-06 and asks Redwood to gross-up for Japanese withholding. they want payment this week.
Ben (Billing): paste vendor note? need to check SOW/PO.
Asha (Finance Ops): vendor says 'we are a JP KK and require gross-up to cover statutory withholding, otherwise we will accept net with withholding deducted.' invoice attached.
Priya (Tax): short take — JP withholding can apply to consulting/tech if sourced to Japan. gross-up increases our cost; we need contract language or CFO sign-off. ask for entity docs & withholding cert.
Ben (Billing): PO on hold until tax confirms. payments@redwood please hold wires for this vendor.
invoice-bot: When withholding applies AP needs: original invoice, remittance, vendor withholding certificate/receipt for reclaim, vendor tax ID/registry, bank details. addendum required if gross-up approved.
Asha (Finance Ops): I'll ask vendor for corporate registry, tax residency, and whether they can produce a JP withholding receipt if we withhold. also told them gross-up needs contract amendment + CFO approval. cc'd payments@redwood.
Vendor (via Asha): replied — they are a Japan KK, cannot claim treaty relief, and want gross-up.
Priya (Tax): I'll draft a short memo for CFO: estimated incremental cost, compliance notes, mitigation (require reclaim evidence), and recommend next steps.
Ben (Billing): quick cash impact estimate posted here: assuming 10.21% withholding, gross-up adds ~JPY 1,137,000 on a JPY 11,130,000 invoice. will confirm statutory rate with AP.
Asha (Finance Ops): action items: Asha hold payment and collect docs; Ben calc final cash impact + keep PO on hold; Priya prepare CFO memo.
Priya (Tax): note — if they bill from a JP branch vs foreign parent treatment may change withholding. ask them to confirm legal billing entity.
Ben (Billing): if CFO approves gross-up we need procurement ok for incremental spend. I'll prepare cost approval request.
Asha (Finance Ops): vendor says they're willing to sign amendment but wants payment this week. escalating to CFO for pre-approval now. will update when CFO responds.
Priya (Tax): if we end up withholding and vendor provides certificate later we can consider refunding withheld amount after verification (timeline 4–8 weeks).
Ben (Billing): tagging payments@redwood again to ensure settlement is blocked until we have clearance.
Asha (Finance Ops): keeping thread here as canonical record. will upload vendor docs to shared drive when received and post link.
